findings.evidence: Step 4 says a contents check 'Not Found (HTTP 404)' means moved and step 5, but audit.py fetch_source_updated treats an empty commits array as IndexError and reports error 'list index out of range', so a deleted path never reaches error null
findings.fix: In the step-3 table, keep 'list index out of range' on a github-path row as the only path-gone signal and send it to step 5. In step 4, use the contents check to confirm the stored path still exists before classifying a row whose error is already null; do not say a contents 404 is how a deleted path is detected.
